description: This file defines the ContentService interface for managing content in a CMS, including methods for listing, retrieving, adding, removing, and updating content and associated files for merchant stores.

classes.name: ContentService
classes.description: Interface for content management operations related to merchant stores, including listing, retrieving, adding, removing, and updating content and files.

methods.description: Lists content by type for a specific merchant store and language.

methods.description: Retrieves content by code for a merchant store.

methods.name: addContentFiles
